bio.text: Ed Kemon of Vergennes is the Republican candidate for Vermont Attorney General in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The Vermont Republican committee chose Kemon in August 2026 to replace H. Brooke Paige, who withdrew after being certified as the winner of the Republican primary for the office.

In Vermont Public's candidate guide, where answers appear as submitted, Kemon lists an occupation of model-based systems engineer and also lists service as president of a Lions Club and as a Fairfax Co. election chief.
